experiments.scope: Deterministic algebraic, import-builder, 4-family prefix-equality, 16-step two-message transplant, and 48/48 planted-key verification for Tuple 124 (k=8, all 48 kappa groups, 1,088 active classes, 62,955,816 exact entries, 52 bit-sliced prefix blocks), plus 255 organizer-seeded random (cv, a0, u) transplant/claw checks.
experiments.hypothesis: Trial 0 asserts the published 39-round SFS collision, exact Tuple-124 import invariants (48 groups, 1,088 classes, 52 prefix blocks, 12,928 unique 18-bit prefixes, bit-identical prefix sets within each 12-group family, K4_MEM=883,201 B <= 2^20, deterministic worst-case pass bound K4_PASS_WC=48,364 < guard reserves), exact 16-step two-message transplant on all 48 group samples, and 48/48 planted W17 hits through the 3-stage shared-prefix k4q pass.
